title: Extract fieldwork::status_db — full status loading with related data
description: Promote common status loading from db_extras.rs into fieldwork. Load a post + its persona account + media attachments + card + tags + mentions + interaction state (favourited/reblogged/muted/bookmarked/pinned) in one call. Returns a StatusBundle struct that servers convert to Mastodon API JSON. Composes: posts_db + persona_db + media_db + cards_db + post_tags_db + mentions_db + interactions_db.
close_reason: All 4 modules created/extended. 428 fieldwork tests pass. 67 new functions across 9 modules.
